name: AgentVQA
description: AgentVQA is a unified benchmark for evaluating agentic capabilities in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) across 14 datasets spanning five agentic domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Understanding. It standardizes diverse tasks into a multiple-choice question format with balanced sample distribution and challenging hard negative options.
reputation: A new multimodal benchmark that is emerging as a useful unified testbed for agentic VLM capabilities across several domains.
notes: Includes hard negative options manually reviewed for correctness; best models achieve around 60% accuracy.
